description.zh:
修改的审计日志配置的ID。
> ID通过[DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~)查询。
description.en:
The ID of the audit log configuration to be modified.
> The ID can be queried via [DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~).

description.zh:
输入多云配置信息：
- AWS：入参 sqsQueueName、sqsRegion
- Tencent：入参 kafkaUserName、kafkaBootstrapServers、kafkaTopic
description.en:
Enter the multi-cloud configuration information:
- AWS: parameters sqsQueueName, sqsRegion
- Tencent: parameters kafkaUserName, kafkaBootstrapServers, kafkaTopic

description.zh:
是否删除此审计日志配置：
- true：删除
- false：不删除
description.en:
Whether to delete this audit log configuration:
- true: Delete
- false: Do not delete

description.zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

- **Tencent**：腾讯云
- **AWS**：AWS
description.en:
Cloud asset vendor. Values:

- **Tencent**: Tencent Cloud
- **AWS**: AWS

title.zh: 修改多云接入对应的审计日志配置信息
title.en: Modify the audit log configuration information for multi-cloud access

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-cloud-vendor-trial-config --auth-id 2300 --vendor Tencent --auth-info sqsRegion_:_us-west-2_,_sqsQueueName_:_0000 --delete-trail true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyCloudVendorTrialConfig --region cn-hangzhou --AuthId 2300 --AuthInfo 'sqsRegion_:_us-west-2_,_sqsQueueName_:_0000' --DeleteTrail true --Vendor Tencent
